# Adaptive Workout Coach

Adaptive Workout Coach is a lightweight guided workout app: pure HTML, CSS,
and JavaScript, no build step, no server, no accounts. It runs as a static
site (GitHub Pages serves the docs/ folder). Open the URL, press Start once,
and follow a 35-minute strength session one move at a time with dumbbells,
resistance bands, and bodyweight.

## The program

One 35-minute session (SESSION_MINUTES in docs/program.js) built from Ask
AI's program synthesis and a list of 51 moves, each with one verified
YouTube demo URL. Each session draws new moves:

- Warm-up, about 5 minutes: pulse raiser, hip hinge, shoulder, glute, and
  squat pattern, with 10 seconds between.
- Main, about 25 minutes: 8 moves, 2 per focus area in this order: lower
  body, upper body, knee strength and stability, arms. Lower-body moves are
  3 straight sets (2 if the session would pass 36 minutes), the others 2.
  Rest is 45 seconds after lower-body sets and 30 seconds after the others.
- Knee group: no jumping, no running, no deep or loaded knee bends, no
  dumbbells. Every knee screen says "Stop if you feel sharp pain."
- Cool-down, about 5 minutes: easy walk and four stretches.

It is a workout companion, not a personal prescription and not medical
advice. It is provided as-is with no warranty. Use it at your own risk and
consult a clinician before starting.

## What the app does

- Guided session screens: start (length, count, phase breakdown, Start),
  exercise (name, dose, demo, phase, "Exercise N of M", progress bar),
  rest (countdown, Up next, Skip rest), and finish (Workout complete,
  exercises done, total time).
- Rep moves wait for Done. Timed moves count down and advance by
  themselves; Done ends them early. Pause/Resume, Skip exercise, and End
  with a confirm.
- One state object in localStorage (awc-guided-session-v1) so a reload
  resumes the same move and time. Cleared on finish or End.
- One demo video at a time from youtube-nocookie.com, never autoplay,
  sandboxed, rel=0. Later sets show no video. URLs are never invented.
- Screen Wake Lock where supported, polite live announcements, reduced
  motion respected, mobile first.
- A Sun-Sat calendar of trained days under awc-demo-v1. Older phase-era
  and workout-type-era saves load quietly and keep their trained days.
- No accounts, no analytics, no tracking, no personal data.

## Project layout

- docs/index.html: page shell. A Content-Security-Policy meta tag limits the
  page to its own files (img-src 'self', connect-src 'none') and allows demo
  frames from https://www.youtube-nocookie.com only.
- docs/session-engine.js, docs/session-screens.js, docs/session.css: the
  guided session, shared byte-for-byte with the kids workout app.
- docs/program.js: the 51 moves and the session builder.
- docs/app.js: calendar store, migration, page wiring.
- docs/styles.css: colors, light/dark aware.
- docs/specs/guided-session.md: the session spec.
- test/: node:test suites. Run with npm test. Not served from docs/.
- README.md, FEATURES.md, llms.txt.

## How to run it

Live: https://jhanisusM.github.io/adaptive-workout-coach/ (GitHub Pages,
deploys from docs/ on every push to main).

Locally: serve the docs/ folder with any static file server, e.g.
`cd docs && python3 -m http.server 8000`, then open http://localhost:8000.

Tests: `npm ci && npm test` from the repository root.

## Safety

This is a workout companion, not medical advice. Sharp pain is a stop sign.
A fixed footer line reads "Personal research project. Not medical advice; use
at your own risk." That line links to the README Disclaimer on GitHub. The
source is public on GitHub. All rights reserved.
